summary.goal: Define Zod schemas for step-level Specification - structured implementation details for architecture, design, testing, and security per step
summary.context: Specification is STEP-LEVEL (not plan-level). Each step can have its own micro-specifications detailing architecture decisions, design elements, test cases, and security requirements relevant to that step.
summary.model_decision: Hybrid model: Plan-level Understanding (ideation context) + Step-level Specification (implementation details per step)
